planning.title: Monthly Budget Cycle Diagram
planning.subtitle: Plan • Spend • Track • Save • Grow. A continuous 6-phase money management roadmap.

phases.title: Set Income
phases.action: Calculate guaranteed take-home pay before planning allocations.
phases.rule: Only count net, reliable cash inflow for the month.

phases.title: Plan Budget
phases.action: Assign every rupee a role using the 50/30/20 benchmark guideline.
phases.rule: Allocate 50% needs, 30% wants, and reserve 20% savings first.

phases.title: Spend Wisely
phases.action: Prioritize essential payments and pause before discretionary splurges.
phases.rule: Apply the 24-Hour Rule for non-essential purchases over Rs. 2,000.

phases.title: Track Expenses
phases.action: Log daily transactions in your planner or expense tracker.
phases.rule: Record daily outflows to eliminate month-end budget surprises.

phases.title: Save Regularly
phases.action: Automate transfers into your emergency reserve and goal sinking funds.
phases.rule: Pay yourself first as soon as your income arrives.

phases.title: Review & Adjust
phases.action: Audit category spending patterns at month-end and refine your plan.
phases.rule: Celebrate milestones and adjust limits for seasonal demands.

mistakes.title: Common Student Money Mistakes & Solutions
mistakes.subtitle: Avoid these 5 common financial pitfalls • Build better habits • Secure your future.

cases.name: Impulse Buying
cases.tagline: Want it now, regret it later.
cases.scenario: Riya went to the mall for stationery but bought expensive headphones because they were on sale.
cases.correction: Pause before buying. Wait 24 hours and ask yourself: 'Do I really need this?'

cases.name: Small Expenses Ignore Karna
cases.scenario: Ayaan ignored daily micro-expenses like coffee (Rs. 300), snacks (Rs. 200), and cold drinks (Rs. 150). By month-end, small daily items totaled Rs. 19,500!
cases.correction: Track every small expense in a planner or mobile app daily.

cases.name: Late Payments
cases.scenario: Rizwan forgot to pay his student internet bill on time and had to pay punitive overdue charges.
cases.correction: Note due dates and set phone calendar reminders to pay on time and avoid extra fees.

cases.name: Unused Subscriptions
cases.tagline: Paying for what you don't use.
cases.scenario: Sara was paying monthly for 3 streaming apps and a gym membership she hardly used.
cases.correction: Review all recurring subscriptions every 30 days. Cancel anything unused for over a month.

cases.name: Without Planning Spending
cases.scenario: Usman received Rs. 10,000 monthly allowance and did not plan his spending. By mid-month, he had zero money left.
cases.correction: Make a simple 50-30-20 budget: Income - Needs - Wants - Savings. Plan before you spend.
